name: linux-ci-runtime
goal: Run unchanged full checks on clean Linux runners with browser, PDF and native display dependencies

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Clean Linux full checks need the locked Chromium, Python PDF libraries and a virtual display; keep all tests and gates.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: CI 38196164783/job114639161709: package tests fail on missing Chromium and reportlab. Failure log retained in work/collaboration-ci-red.log.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Existing runners now install the locked browser, pinned PDF venv and Xvfb. YAML/format checks pass; assertions and failure gates unchanged.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: CI 38201726487/job114656389697 passed the unchanged full check at cd2f6f9; media tests keep their 5s deadline.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Full Linux CI, local full checks and packaged Mac acceptance pass. UI code unchanged; inspected captures retained outside Git.
